historical_comparison: One reused scene, ascending seeds, exact success and length, reward absolute tolerance 1e-6; stop on first mismatch.
f2g_action_comparison: Fresh scene, exact action sequence and task outcome versus unchanged G13 F2G baseline on only the first F2G case; this is regression, not new independent confirmation.
model_probe: Repeat F2G fixed 22D replay-observation candidate-score, latent, reward-logit, Q, and action hash probe exactly.
telemetry: For each step, require 22 SOFA substeps, finite nonnegative force, FTI consistency with the 22 passive monitor substep magnitudes at dt=0.006 s, and no simulation error.
runtime: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0, steve_tdmpc conda environment, Generic SOFA; no CPU fallback
stop_rule: No continuation runner work or future-pilot readiness claim if historical gate, F2G action/model regression, or force telemetry invariants fail.
